tagline: Snap it. Sip it. Seal it.
one_liner: SnapSip is a magnetic lid that turns any can into a leak-proof travel cup in one click.

slides.title: Ever tipped a soda into your car's cup holder?
slides.body: Forty billion cans a year in the US. Not one of them closes.
slides.say: Sharks, raise your hand if you've ever spilled half a can in your car. Forty billion cans a year in America and not one of them closes. Until now.

slides.title: One click. Zero spills.
bullets: Food-grade magnetic ring grips any 12 oz or 16 oz can
slides.say: Watch. Click, it's on. Slide, it's sealed. Turn it upside down: not a drop. It fits every standard can and every cup holder.

slides.title: $410k in 14 months
slides.say: We launched fourteen months ago. Four hundred and ten thousand dollars in sales, four point six stars on almost four thousand reviews, and thirty-one percent of customers come back for a second pack.

slides.title: $2.10 to make. $14.99 to buy.
bullets: Amazon fees and ads ~ $6.40 per unit
slides.say: It costs me two dollars ten to make. It sells for fourteen ninety-nine. After Amazon and ads I keep about six fifty a unit.

slides.title: Designed by someone who spills
slides.body: I'm an industrial designer. I built forty prototypes in my garage before one survived a pothole test.
slides.say: I'm an industrial designer, and a professional spiller. Forty prototypes in my garage before one survived my pothole test.

ask.line: I'm asking for two hundred fifty thousand dollars for ten percent, and a shark who can put SnapSip on a shelf.

elevator_60s: SnapSip is a magnetic lid that turns any can into a leak-proof travel cup. It costs $2.10 to make and sells for $14.99. In 14 months we've sold $410k with 4.6 stars on 3,900 reviews and 31% repeat purchase. I want $250k for 10% to get into retail.
